notes:
Two real drop-in options turned up on the operators' own pages. I couldn't confirm either one for this fall. Nothing here is a Hale confirmation.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Family Play, Shane Homes YMCA at Rocky Ridge (Art Studio B)",
      "age_fit": "families with children under 6 years of age",
      "when": "Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 11:30 am",
      "source_name": "YMCA Calgary"
    },
    {
      "name": "Connect + Play Drop-In at Horizon, Families Matter Family Development Centre",
      "age_fit": "children aged 0–6",
      "price": "Free",
      "source_name": "Families Matter"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **YMCA Calgary:** 
The YMCA's page describes Family Play as a drop-in space for families with children under 6 to explore, create and play together.
 
It lists Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 11:30 am at Shane Homes YMCA at Rocky Ridge (Art Studio B).
 
Families must stay in the room with their children.

- **Families Matter, Horizon (NE Calgary):** 
The page describes free play and connection in a welcoming, child-led environment for children aged 0–6.
 
Their programming is free.
 
No registration is required.
 
The days and times are on their monthly calendars, and I couldn't read those, so no day or time is listed.


I left out the Genesis Centre's Active Toddlers, which showed up only on a listings site. I also left out Mount Pleasant Playgroup, whose page only showed a 2025 session.
